cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.

mechanism: A directs a carefully limited first question to test Dad's reaction before entering the flight-cost conversation.
confusable: Avoiding confrontation alone lacks the structured test and point of A's commitment; S03 controls the probe.
comparison: A family reaction probe differs from a committee's assessment of a financial explanation.
seedUse: Use flight bill, receipt and upgrades; make B propose the revealing document before A corrects the testing method.
